findings.title: Inverted ERC721 onERC721Received selector check
findings.description: require(data != selector) should be require(data == selector). Bricks safeTransferFrom for all legitimate contract recipients.

findings.title: Stale Approval Persistence After Position Transfer
findings.description: getApproved[_tokenId] never cleared after transfer. Previously approved address can steal positions from new owners.

findings.title: calc_base_rewards formula inversion
findings.description: Uses pool_lp * per_second / user_lp instead of user_lp * per_second / pool_lp. Inverts reward calculation.
